rules.description: Both parents must share responsibility for the child from birth or placement
rules.reason_if_failed: You're not eligible if responsibility started after birth or placement. You may be eligible for standard maternity/paternity leave instead.

rules.description: Leave and pay must be taken within first year after birth or placement
rules.reason_if_failed: SPL and ShPP must be taken within the first year after your child is born or placed with your family

rules.description: Claimant must be employed continuously by same employer for at least 26 weeks
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have been employed continuously by the same employer for at least 26 weeks by the relevant qualifying week

rules.description: Claimant must be an 'employee' not a 'worker' for SPL
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be an 'employee' to get SPL. Workers may still qualify for ShPP only.

rules.description: Claimant must earn at least £125 per week on average for ShPP
rules.reason_if_failed: You must earn at least £125 per week on average to qualify for ShPP

rules.description: Partner must have worked 26 weeks out of the 66 weeks before qualifying week
rules.reason_if_failed: Your partner must have worked for at least 26 weeks out of the 66 weeks before the qualifying week

rules.description: Partner must have earned at least £390 in total across 13 of the 66 weeks
rules.reason_if_failed: Your partner must have earned at least £390 in total across any 13 of the 66 weeks before the qualifying week

rules.description: Mother/adopter must curtail maternity or adoption leave to create SPL
rules.reason_if_failed: The mother or adopter must end their maternity or adoption leave early to create SPL. They must give binding notice to their employer.

rules.description: Mother must complete compulsory 2 weeks maternity leave (4 weeks if factory work)
rules.reason_if_failed: The mother cannot return to work before the end of compulsory maternity leave (2 weeks, or 4 weeks for factory workers)

rules.description: Child must be born or placed with family before SPL/ShPP can start
rules.reason_if_failed: You can only start SPL or ShPP once the child has been born or placed with your family

rules.description: At least 8 weeks' written notice must be given to employer
rules.reason_if_failed: You must give your employer at least 8 weeks' written notice of your leave dates

explanation_template: Shared Parental Leave and Pay eligibility: {outcome}. You can share up to {available_weeks} weeks of leave and {available_pay_weeks} weeks of pay.

edge_cases.description: Partner dies during pregnancy or after birth/placement
edge_cases.action: Special provisions apply. The surviving parent may still be able to take SPL/ShPP. Route to bereavement support and specialist caseworker.

edge_cases.description: Child dies or adoption placement disrupted
edge_cases.action: SPL/ShPP continues for 8 weeks after death or disruption. Route to bereavement support.

edge_cases.description: Multiple children born at same time
edge_cases.action: Same total leave/pay applies regardless of number of children. Provide guidance on dividing leave.
Self-employed partner must still meet work history and earnings test. Verify via tax returns and bank statements.

edge_cases.description: Applicant unclear if they're employee or worker
edge_cases.action: Route to employment status checker. If worker status, may qualify for ShPP only, not SPL.

edge_cases.description: Employer refuses to provide required information or accept SPL request
edge_cases.action: This is a statutory right. Route to ACAS for mediation. May require legal intervention.

edge_cases.description: One or both parents work overseas or for overseas employer
edge_cases.action: Complex eligibility rules apply. Must work in UK or for UK employer with UK establishment. Route to specialist caseworker.
